findings.claim: ALAB 10-K 揭露其主要製造商台積電的晶圓廠與主要經銷商皆位於台灣
findings.excerpt: the foundry used by our primary manufacturer, TSMC, as well as our primary distributor, is located in Taiwan

findings.claim: 10-K 風險揭露：若台積電無法供應足量晶圓，ALAB 出貨與營收會受損
findings.excerpt: if TSMC is unable to supply us with sufficient quantities of wafers to meet all of our requirements

findings.claim: FY2024 10-K 稱製造夥伴、經銷商與多數營收集中於台灣、中國、南韓；FY2025 年報再加入新加坡，且多數營收來自東亞
findings.source: Astera Labs Form 10-K FY2024 / Form ARS FY2025 (SEC)，經搜尋摘要轉述

findings.claim: IPO 招股書指出台灣地震風險因晶圓廠鄰近斷層帶而顯著，且可能無法以合理條件取得替代產能
findings.excerpt: the risk of an earthquake in Taiwan and elsewhere in the Pacific Rim region on our business is significant due to the proximity of major earthquake fault lines to the foundry's facilities

findings.claim: 第三方彙整站 policyrisk.com 評 ALAB 製造曝險為高，稱約 73% 不動產及設備位於台灣，且 2025 年單一終端客戶占營收逾 70%、前三大約 86%（第三方轉述，非原始 filing 逐字）

note: 未取得 FY2025 10-K 是否列第二家晶圓廠的證據；「單點失效／唯一製造商」字樣僅見第三方站。as_of 取財年末，實際 filing 日未驗證；policyrisk as_of 為估計值。
